==Description==
'''Happy Home of Robloxia''' is a private server-exclusive [[Maps|map]], which is themed around the 2000's and 2010's of Roblox.

==Design & Path==
'''Happy Home of Robloxia''' takes place on an island in the ocean. The map's style is similar to old Roblox games, with studded parts. On the island, there is a house, a lighthouse and a dock, with multiple cliffs, trees and rocks scattered across the map.

The brown path starts at a cave and ends at a house. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding the cliffs.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Happy Home of Robloxia}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*Cliff towers can be very useful here, as this map has a large amount of cliffs.
**Cliff towers should be placed near the lighthouse, as this spot allows them to cover most of the map.
*Ground towers should generally be placed around the beginning of the map.
**This area of the map has a decent spot for the [[Ace Pilot]], which allows it to cover most of the path.
***The [[Pursuit]] is also quite useful due to the path design.

==Trivia==
*The map is based on how old Roblox games looked.
*The name of the map is a reference to the [[w:c:Roblox:Classic: Happy Home in Robloxia|Classic Home in Robloxia]], a former Roblox template map.
**The home featured in this map is the same as the one featured in older versions of this map.
